rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken way to say that something is caused by A.

example.english: This fire may stem from a short circuit.
example.traditional: 呢場火災可能係由電線短路引起嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 fo2 zoi1 ho2 nang4 hai6 jau4 din6 sin3 dyun2 lou6 jan5 hei2 ge3

rows.note: Use this in formal or written contexts when stressing that something originates or is derived from A.

example.english: The various failures of this policy stem from loopholes in the system.
example.traditional: 呢項政策嘅種種失敗，源於制度漏洞。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 zing3 caak3 ge3 zung2 zung2 sat1 baai6 jyun4 jyu1 zai3 dou6 lau6 dung6

rows.note: Use this when removing a plant, leaf, or fruit stalk before using it.

example.english: Remember to stem the apple before eating it.
example.traditional: 食之前記住幫蘋果去梗。
example.jyutping: sik6 zi1 cin4 gei3 zyu6 bong1 ping4 gwo2 heoi3 gang2
